koreanWordle.title: Korean Wordle
koreanWordle.description: Guess the daily two-syllable word in six tries, changing at midnight in Korea. View the latest 30 daily records and copy spoiler-free grids from completed challenges.
koreanWordle.helpDesc: Guess the 2-syllable word in 6 tries. Only dictionary words are accepted, and each guess colors every jamo.
koreanWordle.helpCorrect: This color means the jamo is in the same syllable and position.
koreanWordle.helpPresent: This color means the jamo is in the word but in a different spot.
koreanWordle.helpAbsent: This color means the jamo is not in the word (or no more copies).
koreanWordle.helpJamo: Each syllable is split into jamo in typing order: 과 = ㄱ·ㅗ·ㅏ, 닭 = ㄷ·ㅏ·ㄹ·ㄱ. Repeated jamo are colored only as many times as they appear in the answer.
koreanWordle.hardModeAfterStart: Hard mode cannot be changed after game starts
koreanWordle.needVowelHint: Add a vowel to complete the syllable
koreanWordle.helpInputDesc: Type consonants and vowels with the on-screen keyboard or your PC keyboard (Dubeolsik layout, Korean IME on or off). Backspace removes the last jamo.
koreanWordle.helpKeyboard: Keyboard colors show what you have learned so far. In hard mode, revealed hints must be used in later guesses.
koreanWordle.hardModeCorrect: {jamo} must be in the correct position

rules.title: Game Rules
items: The daily word changes at midnight KST and is the same for everyone (one play per day)
Guess it in 6 tries using 2-syllable dictionary words
Each syllable is split into jamo: green = right spot, yellow = elsewhere, gray = not in the word
Copy a spoiler-free 🟩🟨⬜ grid to share with friends
Practice mode offers unlimited 2- and 3-syllable words

tips.title: Strategy Tips
items: Start with words that have varied vowels and final consonants (e.g. 강물, 햇살)
Words can repeat a jamo; gray next to a green copy means it appears only once
Compound vowels (ㅘ, ㅟ) and double finals (ㄺ) are scored as two keys
Turn on high contrast mode (orange/blue) if colors are hard to tell apart

whatIs.title: What is Korean Wordle?
whatIs.description: Use jamo hints to guess the daily two-syllable word. Existing daily, practice, hard and color-accessible modes and statistics are preserved. View the latest 30 daily records and share completed grids without switching the current puzzle to an earlier date.

items.q: Can I only play once a day?
items.a: The daily challenge changes at midnight in Korea. Use the existing practice mode for additional two- or three-syllable games.

Thirty is the display limit for recent daily records, not a truncation rule for stored history. Cumulative statistics use all records successfully validated. Data exceeding protective limits or failing validation is preserved without presenting partial statistics as a normal result.

items.q: Can I replay a past puzzle by opening its record?
items.a: Records are read-only. View the date, outcome and attempt count, and expand completed grids without changing the current puzzle's date.

items.q: Does a shared grid reveal the answer?
items.a: A completed daily record shares its date, challenge number, attempt count and colored grid, without the actual answer or guessed words.

items.q: What if saving or copying fails?
items.a: Storage status is reported and current play remains on screen. Damaged records are not silently cleaned and overwritten. On copy failure, use full-grid selection and retry, and distinguish confirmed storage from an unconfirmed save.

history.title: Last 30 daily challenges
history.hint: Your full history is retained. Completed challenges show a result grid without the answer or guessed words.

errors.corrupt: Stored data is malformed and will not be overwritten automatically.
errors.unsupported: A future date or unsupported field has stopped further writes.
errors.tooLarge: The read protection budget (8 MiB or 80,000 days) was exceeded. Original data was not shortened or deleted.
errors.conflict: The saved history differs. Writes have stopped; keep this game or reread the saved history.
errors.writeUnknown: The write could not be confirmed. Further saves are paused until you reread the history.
errors.quota: There is not enough storage space to save this record.
